draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.60, the 239th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 33rd of 37 at CB. He went 245th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (6th percentile). College production: 2 passes defended in 2020, 26th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 32 career games and 6 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2021. Weak spots: passes defended 0 (8th percentile), missed tackle rate 17.9% (8th percentile).
